title: services: arrival resolution (battle, scout, reinforce), reports, MOVEMENT_ARRIVE handler
criteria:
1) realm/services/reports.py (BUILD.md 8.7): create_report(s, player_id, kind, title, data, now) -> Report (created_at = now); list_reports(s, player_id, limit=50, before_id=None) -> list[ReportSummary] newest first (id descending), only that player's reports, `before_id` returns ids smaller than it; get_report(s, player_id, report_id, mark_read=True) -> ReportDetail (sets is_read True when mark_read); unknown id -> GameError NOT_FOUND 'ไม่พบรายงาน'; report of another player -> GameError FORBIDDEN 'ไม่มีสิทธิ์ดูรายงานนี้'.
2) realm/engine/handlers.py: `handle_movement_arrive(s, ev, cfg)` calls military.resolve_arrival(s, ev.payload['movement_id'], ev.due_at, cfg); only that handler changes.
3) realm/services/military.py: replace ONLY the `raise NotImplementedError('T13b')` fall-through of resolve_arrival with the missions attack, raid, scout, reinforce as described below; do not change send_troops, preview_send, recall_reinforcement, create_return_movement or the 'return' branch.
Tests (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; world = worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=2, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0); A = the human's village at (0,0); B = bot 1's village, C = bot 2's village; force geometry/tribes with direct DB updates: B.x=7,B.y=0; set bot players' tribe explicitly (bot1 'ironwild', bot2 'ironwild', human stays 'stonehold'); set B.wood/stone/iron/food = 750 and B.res_updated_at = the arrival time so settling adds nothing; Movement rows are inserted DIRECTLY (not via send_troops) with mission/units/to_village_id/arrive_at and then military.resolve_arrival(s, movement.id, arrive_at, cfg) is called). Hand-computed expectations (speed 1, stonehold target unless noted):
- RAID by the human from A to B with 10 light_cavalry (A_cav = 600) against an empty village: B is ironwild so wall mult irrelevant; defense_power == 10.0, attacker_won True, no losses (int(10*x/(1+x)+0.5) == 0); carry 800 (stonehold carry_mult 1); B stock 750 each so loot = water-filling 800/4 = 200 each; B stock afterwards 550 each; a 'return' movement from_village_id A with units {'light_cavalry': 10}, loot {'wood':200,'stone':200,'iron':200,'food':200}, arrive_at = arrival + 1800 s (7 tiles at speed 14) and a pending MOVEMENT_ARRIVE event; the original movement status 'done'. Reports: one 'battle' report for the human with attacker_won True and loot 200 each and one for bot 1 (the defender); report titles 'ปล้น <B name>' for the attacker and 'ถูกปล้นโดย <A name>' for the defender. Then resolve the return movement at its arrive_at: A's stock is topped up by 200 per resource and capped at capacity (800).
- hideout protects loot: B has a 'hideout' building level 3 (insert Building at a center slot, e.g. slot 21); B's tribe stonehold (hideout mult 1): hidden per resource = 150*1.35**2 = 273.375; 100 light_cavalry raid (carry 8000 > available) -> loot floor(750-273.375) = 476 each and B keeps 274 each.
- defender wins: bot 1 attacks A (mission attack) with 50 light_cavalry (tribe ironwild), A has 100 spearmen (Troop home=A, location=A); stonehold; A_cav = 3000, D_cav = 100*50*1.15 = 5750, defense_power = 5760.0; defender wins; ATTACK: defender loses int(100*x+0.5) = 38 with x = (3000/5760)**1.5 (= 0.37588), A's Troop row now 62; attacker loses all 50 and NO return movement is created; wall unchanged; battle reports exist for the attacker (bot 1) and the defender (human).
- reinforcement defends: same attack but A has NO own troops and bot 2's village C holds Troop(home=C, location=A, unit 'spearman', count 100); the group's tribe is bot 2's tribe 'ironwild' (inf_defense_mult 1.0): D_cav = 100*50 = 5000, defense_power 5010.0; defender wins; the reinforcement row loses int(100*x+0.5) with x = (3000/5010)**1.5 = 0.46337 -> 46 -> count 54; reports go to bot 1, to the human (owner) and to bot 2 (3 distinct players, one report each).
- wall damage: human attacks B (stonehold) with 1000 swordsmen + 30 rams; B's wall (slot 40, type 'wall') level 5; attacker wins; B's wall building level becomes 0 (30 surviving rams: 10+8+6+4+2); report data wall before 5 after 0.
- catapult: 9 catapults + enough infantry, catapult_target 'warehouse' and B has warehouse level 3 -> level 2 after (catapult_per_level 3: cost 9); catapult target missing in B -> a random existing center building of B is chosen with random.Random(f'{world.seed}:{movement.id}') (assert only that some center building of B lost a level or that nothing happens when B has no center building).
- scout: 10 scouts (unit 'scout') vs 0 defending scouts -> success: report kind 'scout' for the attacker with data containing resources (B's stock), troops (units in B) and wall level; a 'return' movement with {'scout': 10}; the defender gets NO report. 10 vs 5 defending scouts (Troop home=B,location=B, 5 scouts) -> success with 4 losses -> return {'scout': 6}, still no defender report. 10 vs 10 -> failure: attacker report title 'หน่วยสอดแนมถูกจับได้ทั้งหมด', defender report 'ตรวจพบการสอดแนมจาก <A name>', no return movement.
- reinforce from A to B with 5 spearmen: a Troop row home=A, location=B count 5 (upsert when it already exists), movement done, reports for both owners (title 'ส่งทัพเสริมไปยัง <B name>' for the sender and 'ได้รับทัพเสริมจาก <A name>' for the receiver).
- attack/raid whose target village no longer exists (to_village_id None or deleted) -> a return movement with the same units, status done, no battle report.
- resolving an already 'done' movement is a no-op; two movements arriving at the same instant at the same target both resolve in sequence without error.
- integration: send_troops(A -> B raid, 10 light_cavalry, now t0 after setting B.protection_until = t0 - 1 day, rally point level 1) then realm.engine.worker.process_next(s, world, t0+1800s, cfg) returns True and B's stock dropped.
reports tests: create/list order/limit/before_id/get marks read/mark_read False/FORBIDDEN/NOT_FOUND.
notes:
DESIGN of resolve_arrival (attack/raid) — follow exactly:
- m = s.get(Movement, id); None or status != 'moving' -> return (existing guard). world = s.get(World, m.world_id). Dispatch on m.mission after the existing 'return' branch.
- ATTACK/RAID: target = s.get(Village, m.to_village_id) if to_village_id is not None else None. If target is None: create_return_movement(s, m.from_village_id, m.to_x, m.to_y, m.player_id, m.units, {}, now, cfg); m.status='done'; flush; after_change(home); return.
- Lock the home (attacker) village and the target village in ASCENDING id order (villages.lock_village for each id in sorted ids); settle both (villages.settle_village(s, v, now, cfg)).
- Defenders: Troop rows with location_village_id == target.id; group by home_village_id: ArmyGroup(tribe = tribe of the player owning that home village, units = {unit: count}, owner_ref = home_village_id). Attacker ArmyGroup(tribe = attacker player's tribe, units = dict(m.units), owner_ref = m.from_village_id). defender_tribe = tribe of the target village's owner. wall_level = level of the target's Building row of type 'wall' (0 if none). Catapult target: only when the attacker has catapults and mission is ATTACK: key = m.catapult_target if the target has a Building row of that type with level > 0 else a random choice (rng) among the target's existing buildings with cfg kind 'center' (sorted by type) else None; catapult_target_level = that building's highest level or None.
- rng = random.Random(f'{world.seed}:{m.id}'). result = combat.resolve_battle(BattleInput(...), cfg, rng).
- Apply: attacker survivors = m.units minus result.attacker_losses (drop zero counts). Defender losses per group: decrement the Troop rows (home=owner_ref, location=target.id), delete rows at 0. Wall: if wall_level_after != wall_level set that Building row level (never delete fixed slot rows). Catapult target building: if after != before set its level; delete the row when level 0 and the building kind is 'center'. Loyalty is Phase 2: ignore loyalty_damage (report field loyalty = None).
- Loot when result.attacker_won: hidden = economy.hideout_capacity(highest hideout level of the target (0 if none), target owner tribe, cfg); loot = combat.plunder(Res of the target stock, hidden, units.carry_capacity(survivors, attacker tribe, cfg)) (carry 0 when no survivors); subtract loot from the target's stock columns. Otherwise loot is zero.
- If there are survivors: create_return_movement(s, m.from_village_id, target.x, target.y, m.player_id, survivors, loot.to_dict(), now, cfg).
- Reports (kind 'battle') to every DISTINCT player involved: the attacker, the target owner, and the owners of reinforcement groups (home player != target owner). data follows the JSON in BUILD.md 8.7 exactly: mission, attacker{player, village{id,name,x,y}, tribe, units, losses}, defenders[{player, village_id, tribe, units, losses}], target{village_id,name,x,y}, attacker_won, attack_power, defense_power, loot{wood,stone,iron,food}, wall{before,after}, catapult (null or {building, before, after}), loyalty null. Titles: attacker f'{label} {target.name}' and every other player f'ถูก{label}โดย {attacker_village.name}' with label 'โจมตี' for attack and 'ปล้น' for raid.
- Finish: m.status = 'done'; flush; villages.after_change for the home and the target village; notify.notify(s, world.id, distinct player ids, 'village', target.id) (and one more for the home village if needed).
SCOUT: attackers = sum of the movement's units; defender_scouts = sum of 'scout' units over ALL Troop rows at the target; success, losses = combat.resolve_scout(attackers, defender_scouts, cfg); survivors = attackers - losses (scout units only). success -> report (kind 'scout', title f'สอดแนม {target.name}') to the attacker only with data {'mission':'scout','success':True,'target':{...},'resources':<target stock dict, floored>,'troops':<sum of units of all groups at target>,'wall':<wall level>,'buildings':{type: highest level}}; failure -> attacker report kind 'scout' title 'หน่วยสอดแนมถูกจับได้ทั้งหมด' data {'mission':'scout','success':False,'target':{...}} and a report kind 'scout' to the target owner titled f'ตรวจพบการสอดแนมจาก {attacker village name}'. Survivors (if any) return via create_return_movement. Lock/settle as above.
REINFORCE: target = the village at to_village_id (None -> return trip as above); upsert Troop(home_village_id=m.from_village_id, location_village_id=target.id, unit) += count; reports kind 'reinforce' to the sender (f'ส่งทัพเสริมไปยัง {target.name}') and, when the owner differs, to the target owner (f'ได้รับทัพเสริมจาก {home.name}'); data {'from_village': brief dict, 'target': brief dict, 'units': units}. Lock both villages in ascending id order.
Thai strings: use ONLY the strings written in single quotes in this task (copy letter by letter; they were proofread); do not type other Thai. Existing constants/messages stay untouched. Never commit, never call datetime.now().
